what: The GPU code of study 5's extension 2 after its fourth and fifth amendments with the E2 top-up's stream-prefix fix merged (the code the judge labels under): the identity of its GPU paths at the commit named.
engineering_check: No run trains under this code. It joins the two records it descends from: the GPU paths changed since extension 2's record after its fifth amendment (docs/study5-extension-2-amendment-5-code-identity.json, 1c92c7d) are the two the top-up's fix changed (docs/study5-topup-fix-code-identity.json, 5ec2905), which qualify a run's terminal records and write the launcher's journal ends, and the one GPU path changed since the fix's record is the linearized replay, which the fifth amendment's record covers. A later GPU change needs a new check and a new record.
